title: rosa canina var. cymosa
intro: Rosa canina var. cymosa, commonly known as the Dwarf Wild Rose or Dwarf Dog Rose, is a variety of the Rosa canina species, a flowering shrub native to Europe and Western Asia. This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and supporting immune function. The therapeutic actions of Rosa canina var. cymosa include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and carotenoids. These constituents work together to provide protective effects against oxidative stress, cell damage, and infections.
